summary.text: Robert Rodriguez is a Democrat who represents District 32 (Arapahoe, Denver and Jefferson counties) in the Colorado State Senate and serves as Majority Leader; Ballotpedia says he took office on January 4, 2019, and lists him as not running for re-election in 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, Rodriguez was born in New Mexico and moved to Colorado at age four.
It says he began his career in a file room and became a senior analyst in the insurance industry.
